1	# Settings client
2	
3	Python 3.9+, standard library only. The public `save(transport, display_name)`
4	accepts strings (including empty strings) and preserves the transport response
5	and exceptions. Other input types to `save` are outside its contract.
6	See [the versioned provider protocol](protocol.md).
7	
8	This increment adds `clear_name(transport)`: request removal of the explicit
9	label so the account default is used. Sending an empty label is not equivalent.
10	The new operation can be called immediately after the client is deployed; it has
11	no local activation flag. Existing `save` behavior must remain unchanged.
12	
13	Run local tests with `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.
14	The test transport records requests; it does not implement a provider.
15
